slides.title: Diagnostics on Data Ministries Already Hold
slides.subtitle: Climate-fiscal analytics tools: section 7 in ten slides
slides.message: Analysis changes policy only when the people who hold the budget can reproduce it. Two tools take data a ministry already holds, put it on one scale and return an answer it can check: an excise diagnostic and a one-page fiscal profile.
slides.author: Stephen J. Stretton · writing in a personal capacity
